items.title: ZDI-CAN-27998: Autodesk
items.description: A CVSS score 7.8 AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H severity vulnerability discovered by 'Mat Powell of Trend Zero Day Initiative' was reported to the affected vendor on: 2025-08-29, 0 days ago. The vendor is given until 2025-12-27 to publish a fix or workaround. Once the vendor has created and tested a patch we will coordinate the release of a public advisory.
